property_summary: For any depositor and any recipient contract, C.withdrawAll never reverts when the recipient's fallback deliberately consumes >2300 gas (low-level call forwards gas), while the mutant using send can cause withdrawAll to revert for some deposit amounts and recipients that exhaust the stipend.
change_summary: Use send instead of low-level call, capturing the boolean and reverting on failure, which changes gas/behavioral characteristics.
